title: Decimal Expansion of Rational Numbers

hero.headline: Terminating or Repeating?
hero.subtext: p/q ka denominator dekh kar bina division kiye pata karo decimal terminate karega ya nahi.

story.text: 1/4 = 0.25 (terminate) lekin 1/3 = 0.333... (repeat, kabhi khatam nahi hota). Farak sirf denominator ke prime factors mein hai — aur ye trick tumhe bina division kiye batayega konsa case hai.

explanation.content: Agar rational number p/q (lowest form, q≠0) ka decimal expansion terminate karta hai, to q ke prime factors sirf 2 aur/ya 5 honge:
Agar q mein 2 ya 5 ke alawa koi aur prime factor hai (jaise 3, 7, 11...), to decimal non-terminating repeating hoga.

examples.problem: 13/3125 ka decimal expansion terminate karega ya nahi?
steps: Sirf 5 hai (2 ya 5 ka combination), koi aur prime nahi

examples.problem: 7/12 ka decimal expansion terminate karega ya nahi?
steps: 3 bhi ek prime factor hai (2,5 ke alawa)

questions.question: 17/8 ka decimal expansion kaisa hoga?
questions.explanation: 8 = 2³, sirf prime factor 2 hai, isliye terminating hoga (17/8 = 2.125).

questions.question: Kaunsa denominator terminating decimal dega?
questions.explanation: q = 5³ mein sirf 5 hai — 2 aur 5 ke alawa koi prime factor nahi, isliye terminating.

notes: Non-terminating repeating ⟺ q mein koi aur prime factor bhi ho
Hamesha p/q ko lowest form mein le kar check karo
summary: Denominator ke prime factors dekh kar hi tum bata sakte ho ki decimal terminate karega ya repeat — bina actual division kiye.
